data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘Elberos’, meaning ‘shining one’ or ‘sun’. In Christianity, Elberta could represent a beacon of faith and hope, shining light in the darkness. The name Elberta carries the meaning “Light, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elberta usually hope their child will grow to embody light, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: אלברטה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלברטה משמעות שם נוצרי אלוהים זוהר ומאיר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלברטה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשם הגרמני 'אדלברט', שמורכב מהמילים 'אדל' (אלוהים) ו'ברט' (זוהר, מאיר). השם אלברטה משמש כנשיאת האור האלוהי והוא קשור לנושאים של אור, תקווה וישועה בנצרות.

in_greek.name: Ελβέρτη
in_greek.meaning: Ελβέρτη σημαίνει Χριστιανικό όνομα Θεού λάμπει και φωτίζει
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ελβέρτη προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα 'Adelbert', που συνδυάζει τις λέξεις 'adel' (Θεός) και 'bert' (λάμπει, φωτίζει). Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Ελβέρτη συμβολίζει το φως του Θεού και συνδέεται με θέματα ελπίδας, σωτηρίας και πνευματικής καθοδήγησης.

in_latin.name: Elberta
in_latin.meaning: Elberta significat nomen christianum Dei splendet et illuminat
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elberta originem habet in nomine germanico 'Adelbert', quod componitur ex vocibus 'adel' (Deus) et 'bert' (splendet, illuminat). In traditione christiana, nomen Elberta refertur ad lucem divinam et habet connotationes spei, salvationis et ductus spiritualis.

in_english.name: Elberta
in_english.meaning: Elberta means Christian name of God shines and illuminates
in_english.long_meaning: The name Elberta originates from the Germanic name 'Adelbert', derived from the words 'adel' (God) and 'bert' (shines, illuminates). In Christian tradition, Elberta symbolizes divine light, hope, and salvation. It conveys spiritual guidance and enlightenment, reflecting the Christian values of faith and redemption.

It may have been seen as a name that honored the historical and cultural background of the faith, emphasizing its connection to the larger human story.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Elberta could be seen as a reminder of the light and hope that comes through faith in God. It could be a name that inspires the bearer to be a shining example of faith in their own life, to bring light and hope to others, and to remain steadfast in their beliefs even in difficult times. The name may serve as a daily reminder of the power and presence of God, and the importance of keeping one’s faith strong and vibrant.
